description: Where the runs of a burst's variants stand, such as those startBurstRun started, with how each variant's latest run ended. Waits up to waitSeconds for none of them to be running and answers as soon as that happens, so call it again while the status is running. A run started in the app or by a schedule counts too.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

waitSeconds.description: How long this call waits for the work to finish, in seconds: the message to the slides agent on `getReportMessage`, the run on `getReportRun`, the batch of variants being added on `getBurstVariantBatch`, the runs of a burst's variants on `getBurstRun`. It returns as soon as the work is done, or as things stand once the time is up, so call it again while `status` is still `queued` or `running`. `0` returns at once. Defaults to `20`; at most `30`.

name: getBurstRun
title: Get burst run
